title: Range against launch angle
brief:
Plots: range in metres against launch angle, from 0° to 90°, for u = 20 m/s with no air resistance.
Points: 0°: 0.0, 15°: 20.4, 30°: 35.3, 45°: 40.8, 60°: 35.3, 75°: 20.4, 90°: 0.0
html:
<script>
const c = Visual.chart({ x: [0, 90], y: [0, 50], xLabel: "Launch angle (degrees)", yLabel: "Range (m)" });
const g = 9.8, u = 20;
let angle = 45;
const data = [[0, 0.0], [15, 20.4], [30, 35.3], [45, 40.8], [60, 35.3], [75, 20.4], [90, 0.0]];
const rangeAt = a => u * u * Math.sin(2 * a * Math.PI / 180) / g;
function draw() {
  c.clear();
  c.fn(a => rangeAt(a), { color: "var(--muted)", dashed: true });
  c.line(data);
  c.dots(data);
  const R = rangeAt(angle);
  const Rr = Math.round(R * 10) / 10;
  c.vline(angle, `${angle}°`);
  c.dots([[angle, R]], { color: "var(--warn)" });
  c.label(angle, R, `${Rr.toFixed(1)} m`);
  c.readout([`angle = ${angle}°`, `range = ${Rr.toFixed(1)} m`, `u = ${u} m/s`]);
  let msg;
  if (angle === 45) msg = `Here, at the peak, 45 degrees, the range is ${Rr.toFixed(1)} m.`;
  else if (angle === 15) msg = `Here, at 15 degrees, the range is ${Rr.toFixed(1)} m.`;
  else if (angle === 90) msg = `Here, at 90 degrees, the range is ${Rr.toFixed(1)} m.`;
  else msg = `At ${angle} degrees, the range is ${Rr.toFixed(1)} m.`;
  Visual.state(`${msg} Range = u² sin(2θ)/g with u = 20 m/s, g = 9.8 m/s², no air resistance.`);
}
Visual.on("angle", v => { angle = v; draw(); });
draw();
</script>
